events.description: Several thousand unaccompanied minors have gathered in Ceuta, a Spanish enclave on the northern coast of Africa. Illness and abuse are rife, and the authorities admit they are overwhelmed.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Minors living alone on Ceuta's streets at risk of abuse

events.title: Dressed for power: Giorgia Meloni and the language of fashion
events.description: From Giorgia Meloni's shift from dark suits to pastels to Angela Merkel's signature jackets, politicians have long used clothing to shape how voters see them. In this day and age, power dressing has evolved.

events.title: Should India be worried about the Mecca defense pact?
events.description: A defense agreement between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkey brings Islamabad deeper into the security architecture of the Middle East. How is India planning to respond?
events.ticker_label: 💥 Should India be worried about the Mecca defense pact?

events.title: German court convicts Ukrainian man over Russia parcel plot
events.description: The court said the man sent packages with GPS trackers from Germany to Ukraine to scope out potential sabotage targets for Russian secret services.

events.title: Champions League: Everything still to play for between Lyon and Fenerbahce
events.description: Olympique Lyonnais and Fenerbahce drew 1–1 in the first leg of their Champions League play-off. The second leg will take place on Wednesday 26 August in Lyon.

events.title: Trump scales back joint military drills between South Korea and US
events.description: South Korea and the US will cut the duration of their annual joint military drills to five days from 11 and scale back some field training, ​the allies said on Wednesday, ‌after President Donald Trump ordered a substantial reduction in US participation. Trump's move could reflect his hopes to re-engage with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

events.title: Fenerbahce fight back against Lyon as Greenwood scores Champions League equaliser
events.description: Mason Greenwood struck a second-half equaliser as Fenerbahce fought back to draw 1-1 at home to Lyon in their Champions League play-off first leg on Tuesday. Lois Openda put Lyon ahead before Greenwood levelled. Viking Stavanger rallied from two goals down to earn a 2-2 draw at Dinamo Zagreb.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Fenerbahce fight back against Lyon as Greenwood scores Champions League equaliser

events.title: Hollywood honours Angelique Kidjo as first Black African Walk of Fame star
events.description: Five-time Grammy winner Angelique Kidjo became the first Black African to receive a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on Tuesday, marking a milestone for African music. The Beninese-French singer was honored at a ceremony in Los Angeles attended by film stars and leading figures from the music industry.

events.title: Trump says no Iran talks planned as UAE suspends trade with Tehran
events.description: US President Donald Trump said Tuesday no talks with Iran were planned and insisted the Strait of Hormuz remained open despite reduced shipping traffic. Oman and Iran neared a deal on the waterway as a projectile struck a vessel, while the UAE said two Iranian ballistic missiles landed in or near its waters.
events.ticker_label: 🪖 Trump says no Iran talks planned as UAE suspends trade with Tehran

events.title: France to expel two Iranian diplomats as arrests row heightens
events.description: Paris is to expel two Iranian diplomats serving in France following the banning by Iran of two French diplomats posted to the embassy in Tehran, French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said Tuesday. He said Iran's treatment of the French diplomats briefly arrested in Tehran last month over accusations of "interference" in Iran's internal affairs was "intolerable".

events.title: In Ceuta, migrants stranded at Europe’s gates await their fate
events.description: Weeks after some 70,000 migrants tried to cross from Morocco into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, the ones who chose to stay have settled on El Trampolin beach. They hail from various countries, speak different languages and crossed many borders to get to this strip of sand. Europe seems very close, and yet so far.
events.ticker_label: 💥 In Ceuta, migrants stranded at Europe’s gates await their fate

events.description: Donald Trump has announced he has paused the imposition of 50% tariffs on more goods from Canada.

events.description: Archaeologists in Peru have unveiled skeletal remains near Huaca Pucllana, an ancient pyramid in Lima

events.description: Amid ongoing deadly hostilities in Gaza, the enclave’s farmers face the increasingly difficult challenge of finding safe land to grow their crops.

events.title: The grass beneath our feet: Why rangelands matter
events.description: In northern Kenya, a herder scans the sky for rain that hasn't come. The grass his animals need is thinning by the day.

events.title: Former rebel fighters join campaign against Ebola in the DR Congo
events.description: Demobilised former combatants are actively joining the fight against Ebola by participating in public information campaigns in the east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

events.description: Georgina Bribiesca Chavez and Salvador Pelayo allegedly made tens of thousands selling exotic animals smuggled across the U.S.-Mexico border since 2023.

events.description: Surveillance video shows 40 suspects ransacking A-Z Market in Bellflower after power tools were used to breach the security gate during a street takeover.

events.description: Prosecutors asked Lindsay Clancy's Catholic mother-in-law if murder is a mortal sin, attempting to prove Clancy knew right from wrong in Duxbury case.

events.title: Manhunt underway after off-duty Massachusetts police veteran found dead at woman's home
events.description: Karen Solomon, 58, is being sought in a Massachusetts manhunt after a veteran Worcester police officer was found dead at her Massachusetts home.

events.title: Alex Murdaugh moves for new home for double-murder retrial
events.description: Alex Murdaugh's defense team is pushing to move his double murder retrial to Richland County, citing a larger jury pool and lower costs than Charleston.

events.title: South Korean president jumps to invest in military after Trump cuts joint exercises
events.description: Lee Jae Myung urged stronger independent South Korean military capabilities after Trump ordered cuts to U.S.-South Korean Ulchi Freedom Shield drills.

events.title: Spain stocks African enclave Ceuta with boosted security as Morocco monitors calls for second border rush
events.description: Spain's African enclave Ceuta sees soldiers patrolling streets, and Morocco says it arrested those inciting a second mass border crossing on Saturday.

events.title: Construction workers uncover $10 million in gold while building sewer under former brewery
events.description: Construction workers in Belgium discovered $10 million in gold coins and bars while building a sewer, but a finder's fee remains uncertain.
